description: This source file is a shell script for testing the integration of Git with Perforce (p4), focusing on mocking Large File Storage (LFS) operations. It sets up repository scenarios, performs file operations, and verifies the correct handling and storage of large files based on size and extension rules in a mock environment.

methods.name: test_file_is_not_in_mock_lfs
methods.description: Verifies that a specified file is not stored in the mock LFS storage and contains expected content.

methods.name: test_file_is_in_mock_lfs
methods.description: Checks that a specified file is stored in the mock LFS local and remote storage with expected content, indicating it was treated as a large file.

methods.name: test_file_is_deleted_in_mock_lfs
methods.description: Ensures that a file marked for deletion has been removed from working directory but remains in the storage, simulating a delete operation.

methods.name: test_file_count_in_dir
methods.description: Counts files in a directory to verify the number of stored mock LFS files matches expectations.
